review.notes: All 32 physical pages diffed word-by-word (case/punctuation-normalized) against the OCR markdown; pages 1, 2, 10, 14, 15, 18, 23, 27, 29 rendered at 120 dpi and visually inspected. Code fences are balanced (6 openers, info strings, all closed). Remaining diff hits are figure-internal text (bar-chart and t-SNE axis labels/legends on pages 4, 7, 8, 10, 30), LaTeX math the OCR renders as LaTeX, and soft-hyphen splits the OCR joined correctly. The odd punctuation of reference [23] ('. In: URL ... ().') matches the PDF's own BibTeX output on physical p.21 and was left unchanged. Reference [23] also prints 'arxiv. org' with a space on p.21, but the URL host 'arxiv.org' reads correctly in the OCR; left unchanged.

unresolved.evidence: Bar-chart tick labels and t-SNE legend/category words (e.g. 'databases image', 'cloud platforms calendar management cryptocurrency', axis tick sequences) are interleaved with captions in OCR order but are figure-internal text; no repair required.

Reference [23] prints '... 2024a". In: URL https://arxiv. org/abs/2411.07140 ().' including the trailing '()' and a space inside 'arxiv. org'; the OCR reproduces the same odd punctuation (with a correct 'arxiv.org'). Quirks originate in the PDF's own BibTeX output, so no patch.
